documents.title: Photometer operating facts
documents.text: An identified glass filter in the keyed holder can be measured with read_transmittance. This command takes a wavelength in nm and returns reference-corrected percent transmittance for the filter currently in the holder. The same holder is used for both filters.

documents.title: Qualified channels
documents.text: The two calibrated comparison channels are 520 nm and 635 nm. The study selects a single channel shared by both filters; these are alternatives.

experiment.title: Glass filter transmission comparison
experiment.goal: Compare percent transmittance of glass filters A and B at the study wavelength.

documents.title: Filter comparison brief
documents.text: The samples are labeled A and B. One reading per filter is requested, using the same study wavelength. Report the value for each filter and the difference A minus B in percentage points.
